messages:
incident-bot: Pager alert: SLO breach detected for streaming.tail.p99 in eu-west-2 > 1.5s (03:12 UTC). Affected routes: /v1/stream, /v1/chat/stream. Several customer streaming sessions experiencing stalls. Alert: <https://grafana.redwood/alerts/streaming-p99>

samir: ack — I'm on call. priya, miguel, net-sre please triage. any deploys in last 30m?

priya: no deploys. spike started ~03:10 UTC. infra metrics show increased inter-zone retransmits and TLS handshake failures between eu-west-2 AZs and our us-east-1 egress cluster.

miguel: tracing shows initial connection stalls — client connects, TLS handshake times out, server-side token loop waiting on ACKs. This manifests as streaming stalls (tail tokens not delivered).

net-sre: I'm seeing SYN retransmit patterns and elevated RTOs on NAT egress nodes for eu-west-2 -> us-east paths. Ephemeral port usage looks within thresholds, but queues on some NAT hosts are high. Capturing packets from a sample host now.

net-sre: ```
# tcpdump -n -i eth0 'tcp[tcpflags] & (tcp-syn|tcp-ack) != 0' -c 40
03:10:11.123456 IP 10.0.5.21.50624 > 34.67.89.3.443: Flags [S], seq 12345, win 64240, options [mss 1460,sackOK,TS val 98765 ecr 0], length 0
03:10:11.443789 IP 10.0.5.21.50624 > 34.67.89.3.443: Flags [S], seq 12345, win 64240, options [mss 1460], length 0 (retransmit)
03:10:12.553000 IP 10.0.5.21.50624 > 34.67.89.3.443: Flags [S], seq 12345, win 64240, length 0 (retransmit)
```

priya: DNS seems healthy overall, but client-side DNS RTOs ticked up from a subset of AZs — could be part of the same cross-zone congestion. p95 for streaming tail tokens climbed first, then p99.

dave: immediate mitigation idea: prefer same-zone egress for streaming-heavy routes to avoid cross-zone NAT path. We can roll a traffic steering change as a canary.

samir: do it. start at 5% traffic for canary. priya, net-sre, watch TLS handshake success and SYN retransmits. elaine, prep a brief customer note.

dave: executing canary:

```bash
# rctl routing update --route streaming --egress-preference same-zone --canary 5%
```

ops-bot: routing change submitted: change-id rchg-20260315-01

net-sre: initial metrics after canary: SYN retransmits down ~65% for canary flows; TLS handshake timeout rate for canary down from 3.2% -> 0.8%.

miguel: p99 for canary streaming tail improved from ~1.8s -> ~0.5s. Looks promising. pushing canary to 25%.

dave: bumping to 25%.

ops-bot: routing change update: change-id rchg-20260315-01 progress: 25%

priya: monitoring: global p99 slowly decreasing as we increase weight. Some AZs still show higher retransmit rates — likely a set of NAT hosts in a particular placement group.

net-sre: I'm isolating NAT nodes with high tx-queue; collecting per-host qdisc stats and kernel retransmit counts. Opening NET ticket with host list.

elaine: customer comms drafted: "We're investigating intermittent streaming stalls affecting a subset of sessions in eu-west-2. A mitigation has been rolled out and latency is improving. We'll follow up with a full update once we've completed root cause analysis." sending to affected contacts now. :white_check_mark:

samir: good. plan: finish rolling to 100% if no regression, then keep elevated monitoring for 60m. postmortem owners: net-sre (root cause), miguel (reproducer/trace), dave (routing guardrail), priya (SLO analysis), elaine (customer comms).

net-sre: rolling to 50% now. I'm also running targeted traceroute to egress cluster to see path differences.

miguel: creating a local traffic replay in staging to try to reproduce the handshake stalls. will run a gremlin of 2% packet loss + 50ms cross-AZ latency to see impact.

dave: note — if same-zone egress is used regularly it increases cost. we'll need a guardrail: auto-fall back to cross-zone when same-zone saturates. adding an alert for egress-cost-saturation.

ops-bot: routing change update: change-id rchg-20260315-01 progress: 100% -> completed

net-sre: after full rollout, cluster-wide SYN retransmits down ~58% vs peak. TLS handshake success rate back to baseline. p99 streaming tail back to acceptable SLOs.

samir: excellent. leaving monitoring on for 1h. next actions: net-sre to collect full pcaps and route table diffs and attach to NET-7891. miguel to post reproducer logs. dave to add opt-in routing guardrail and a runbook note.

priya: documenting timeline and metrics in the incident runbook: <https://confluence.redwood/incident/streaming-tail-eu-2026>

incident-bot: Incident created: https://incidents.redwood/incident/4681234567 (severity: S2).

elaine: final customer update posted: "Mitigation applied; streaming latency improved to within normal range. Engineering investigating the underlying cross-zone egress congestion and will provide a follow-up." :white_check_mark:

samir: handing off monitoring to priya for the night. if we see recurrence, page me immediately. closing active mitigation loop in 60m if stable.

priya: ack, I'm on deck. I'll post an update in 30m with p99/p95 snapshots and any anomalies.

dave: for postmortem: include exact routing commands, canary progression, cost tradeoffs, and a suggested automation to prefer same-zone egress for low-latency streaming when available.

samir: thanks team. added postmortem owners and assigned follow-ups. I'll close the oncall handoff once priya confirms stable.
